name: CategoryTheory.Cat.Hom₂.congr_app
statement:
lemma Cat.Hom₂.congr_app {C D : Cat} {F G : C ⟶ D} {η θ : F ⟶ G} (h : η = θ) (X : C) :
    η.toNatTrans.app X = θ.toNatTrans.app X

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.Hom₂.ext_app
statement:
lemma Cat.Hom₂.ext_app {C D : Cat} {F G : C ⟶ D} {η θ : F ⟶ G}
    (h : ∀ X, η.toNatTrans.app X = θ.toNatTrans.app X) : η = θ

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.associator_hom_eq_id
statement:
theorem associator_hom_eq_id {X Y Z W : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W) :
    (α_ f g h).hom = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.associator_hom_toNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem associator_hom_toNatTrans_app (F : B ⟶ C) (G : C ⟶ D) (H : D ⟶ E) (X : B) :
    (α_ F G H).hom.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.associator_inv_eq_id
statement:
theorem associator_inv_eq_id {X Y Z W : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W) :
    (α_ f g h).inv = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.associator_inv_toNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem associator_inv_toNatTrans_app (F : B ⟶ C) (G : C ⟶ D) (H : D ⟶ E) (X : B) :
    (α_ F G H).inv.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.leftUnitor_hom_eq_id
statement: theorem leftUnitor_hom_eq_id {X Y : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (λ_ f).hom = 𝟙 f

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.leftUnitor_hom_toNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom_toNatTrans_app (F : B ⟶ C) (X : B) :
    (λ_ F).hom.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.leftUnitor_inv_eq_id
statement: theorem leftUnitor_inv_eq_id {X Y : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (λ_ f).inv = 𝟙 f

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.leftUnitor_inv_toNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_toNatTrans_app (F : B ⟶ C) (X : B) :
    (λ_ F).inv.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.naturality_1
statement:
lemma Cat.naturality_1 {C D : Cat} {F G : C ⟶ D} (ι : F ≅ G) {X Y : ↑C} (m : X ⟶ Y) :
    ι.inv.toNatTrans.app X ≫ F.toFunctor.map m ≫ ι.hom.toNatTrans.app Y
      = G.toFunctor.map m

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.naturality_2
statement:
lemma Cat.naturality_2 {C D : Cat} {F G : C ⟶ D} (ι : F ≅ G) {X Y : ↑C} (m : X ⟶ Y) :
    ι.hom.toNatTrans.app X ≫ G.toFunctor.map m ≫ ι.inv.toNatTrans.app Y
      = F.toFunctor.map m

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.rightUnitor_hom_eq_id
statement: theorem rightUnitor_hom_eq_id {X Y : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (ρ_ f).hom = 𝟙 f

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.rightUnitor_hom_toNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_toNatTrans_app (F : B ⟶ C) (X : B) :
    (ρ_ F).hom.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.rightUnitor_inv_eq_id
statement: theorem rightUnitor_inv_eq_id {X Y : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (ρ_ f).inv = 𝟙 f

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.rightUnitor_inv_toNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_toNatTrans_app (F : B ⟶ C) (X : B) :
    (ρ_ F).inv.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Cat.toCatHom₂_toNatTrans
statement:
@[simp] lemma Cat.toCatHom₂_toNatTrans {C D : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₁} D]
    {F G : C ⥤ D} (η : F ⟶ G) : (NatTrans.toCatHom₂ η).toNatTrans = η

name: CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj
statement:
@[to_app]
lemma Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj {B : Type u₁} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B]
    {C : Type u₂} [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] {F G : B ⥤ᵖ C} (α : F ⟶ G) {y z : B}
    {v v' : y ⟶ z} (σ : v ⟶ v') :
    F.map₂ σ ▷ α.app z = (α.naturality v).hom ≫ α.app y ◁ G.map₂ σ ≫ (α.naturality v').inv

name: CategoryTheory.modification_naturality_app
statement:
lemma modification_naturality_app {C : Type u₁} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} C]
    {F G : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}} {η θ : F ⟶ G} (Γ : η ⟶ θ) {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (z : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    (Γ.as.app b).toNatTrans.app ((F.map f).toFunctor.obj z) ≫
      (θ.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app z =
    (η.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app z ≫
      (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((Γ.as.app a).toNatTrans.app z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.cat_unitor_block
statement:
lemma cat_unitor_block {X Y Z : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ((ρ_ f).hom ≫ (λ_ f).inv) ▷ g = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.cat_whiskerLeft_leftUnitor
statement:
lemma cat_whiskerLeft_leftUnitor {X Y Z : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    f ◁ (λ_ g).hom = 𝟙 (f ≫ g)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.cat_whiskerLeft_leftUnitor_app
statement:
lemma cat_whiskerLeft_leftUnitor_app {X' Y' Z' : Cat.{v, u}} (f : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Z')
    (W : ↑X') : (f ◁ (λ_ g).hom).toNatTrans.app W = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.map_comp_cancel
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma map_comp_cancel {D E : Type*} [Category D] [Category E] (P : D ⥤ E) {a b : D}
    (A : a ⟶ b) (B : b ⟶ a) (h : A ≫ B = 𝟙 a) :
    P.map A ≫ P.map B = 𝟙 (P.obj a)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.map_map_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma map_map_comp {D E W : Type*} [Category D] [Category E] [Category W]
    (Q : D ⥤ E) (P : E ⥤ W) {a b c : D} (A : a ⟶ b) (B : b ⟶ c) :
    P.map (Q.map A) ≫ P.map (Q.map B) = P.map (Q.map (A ≫ B))

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.modification_naturality_conj
statement:
lemma modification_naturality_conj {α α' : F ⟶ G} (Γ : α ⟶ α') {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (W : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    (Γ.as.app b).toNatTrans.app ((F.map f).toFunctor.obj W)
      = (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W ≫
        (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((Γ.as.app a).toNatTrans.app W) ≫
        (α'.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.naturality_comp_assoc_core
statement:
lemma naturality_comp_assoc_core (α : F ⟶ G) {p q r s : C} (u : p ⟶ q) (v : q ⟶ r) (W : r ⟶ s)
    (x : ↑(F.obj p)) :
    ((G.map W).toFunctor.map ((α.naturality (u ≫ v)).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (G.mapComp (u ≫ v) W).inv.toNatTrans.app ((α.app p).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
          (α.naturality ((u ≫ v) ≫ W)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
      (α.app s).toFunctor.map ((F.map₂ (α_ u v W).hom).toNatTrans.app x) =
    (G.map W).toFunctor.map
        ((α.app r).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (G.mapComp v W).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((α.app q).toFunctor.obj ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (G.map (v ≫ W)).toFunctor.map ((α.naturality u).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (G.mapComp u (v ≫ W)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((α.app p).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
            (α.naturality (u ≫ v ≫ W)).inv.toNatTrans.app x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_comp_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_comp_app (η : F ⟶ G) (θ : G ⟶ H) (a : C) :
    StrongTrans.app (η ≫ θ) a = StrongTrans.app η a ≫ StrongTrans.app θ a

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_comp_naturality_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_comp_naturality_app (δ : F ⟶ G) (α : G ⟶ H) {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (W : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    ((δ ≫ α).naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W
      = (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((δ.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W) ≫
        (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app ((δ.app a).toFunctor.obj W)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app (δ : F ⟶ G) (α : G ⟶ H) {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (W : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    ((δ ≫ α).naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W
      = (α.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app ((δ.app a).toFunctor.obj W) ≫
        (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((δ.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_id_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_id_app (F : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}) (a : C) :
    StrongTrans.app (𝟙 F) a = 𝟙 (F.obj a)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_id_app_toFunctor_map
statement:
lemma strongTrans_id_app_toFunctor_map (F : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}) (a : C)
    {p q : ↑(F.obj a)} (h : p ⟶ q) : ((StrongTrans.app (𝟙 F) a)).toFunctor.map h = h

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_id_naturality_hom
statement:
lemma strongTrans_id_naturality_hom (F : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}) (u : x ⟶ y) :
    (StrongTrans.naturality (𝟙 F) u).hom = (ρ_ (F.map u)).hom ≫ (λ_ (F.map u)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_id_naturality_whiskerRight
statement:
lemma strongTrans_id_naturality_whiskerRight (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    ((StrongTrans.naturality (𝟙 F) u) ▷ᵢ α.app y).hom = 𝟙 (F.map u ≫ α.app y)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_id_naturality_whiskerRight_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_id_naturality_whiskerRight_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (W : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    ((StrongTrans.naturality (𝟙 F) u) ▷ᵢ α.app y).hom.toNatTrans.app W = 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_leftUnitor_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_leftUnitor_app (α : F ⟶ G) (a : C) :
    ((λ_ α).hom).as.app a = (λ_ (StrongTrans.app α a)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_naturality_slide
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma strongTrans_naturality_slide (α : G ⟶ H) {a b : C} (v : a ⟶ b) {W W' : ↑(G.obj a)}
    (m : W ⟶ W') :
    (α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app W ≫
        (H.map v).toFunctor.map ((α.app a).toFunctor.map m) ≫
        (α.naturality v).inv.toNatTrans.app W'
      = (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((G.map v).toFunctor.map m)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_rightUnitor_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_rightUnitor_app (α : F ⟶ G) (a : C) :
    ((ρ_ α).hom).as.app a = (ρ_ (StrongTrans.app α a)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_hom
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_hom (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).hom
      = (F.mapComp u v).hom ▷ (α.app z ≫ β.app z) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map v) (α.app z ≫ β.app z)).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (F.map v) (α.app z) (β.app z)).inv ≫
          (α.naturality v).hom ▷ β.app z ≫
          (α_ (α.app y) (G.map v) (β.app z)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map v ≫ β.app z)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_hom_app
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_hom_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).hom.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (α.app z ≫ β.app z).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (β.app z).toFunctor.map
            ((α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_id_left_hom
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_id_left_hom (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    (evalMapComp (𝟙 x) (𝟙 F) u α).hom
      = (F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom ▷ (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y)).hom ≫
        F.map (𝟙 x) ◁ ((α_ (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y)) (α.app y)).inv ≫
          ((ρ_ (F.map u)).hom ≫ (λ_ (F.map u)).inv) ▷ α.app y ≫
          (α_ (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u) (α.app y)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u ≫ α.app y)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_id_right_hom
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_id_right_hom (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    (evalMapComp u α (𝟙 y) (𝟙 G)).hom
      = (F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv ≫
          (α.naturality (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ 𝟙 (G.obj y) ≫
          (α_ (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y)) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y) ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_inv
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_inv (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).inv
      = (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map v ≫ β.app z)).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (α.app y) (G.map v) (β.app z)).inv ≫
          (α.naturality v).inv ▷ β.app z ≫
          (α_ (F.map v) (α.app z) (β.app z)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map v) (α.app z ≫ β.app z)).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp u v).inv ▷ (α.app z ≫ β.app z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_inv_app
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_inv_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).inv.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (β.app z).toFunctor.map
            ((α.naturality v).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        (α.app z ≫ β.app z).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).inv.toNatTrans.app Z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMap_id_id
statement: lemma evalMap_id_id (x : C) (F : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}) : evalMap (𝟙 x) (𝟙 F) = F.map (𝟙 x)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMap₂_eq_exchange
statement:
lemma evalMap₂_eq_exchange {u u' : x ⟶ y} {α α' : F ⟶ G} (σ : u ⟶ u') (Γ : α ⟶ α') :
    evalMap₂ σ Γ = (F.map u ◁ Γ.as.app y) ≫ (F.map₂ σ ▷ α'.app y)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMap₂_leftUnitor
statement:
lemma evalMap₂_leftUnitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (λ_ u).hom (λ_ α).hom
      = F.map₂ (λ_ u).hom ▷ (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y) ≫
        F.map u ◁ (λ_ (α.app y)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMap₂_rightUnitor
statement:
lemma evalMap₂_rightUnitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (ρ_ u).hom (ρ_ α).hom
      = F.map₂ (ρ_ u).hom ▷ (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)) ≫
        F.map u ◁ (ρ_ (α.app y)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_associator
statement:
lemma eval_associator (s : x ⟶ y) (δ : F ⟶ G) (u : y ⟶ z) (α : G ⟶ H)
    (v : z ⟶ t) (β : H ⟶ E) :
    evalMap₂ (α_ s u v).hom (α_ δ α β).hom
      = (evalMapComp (s ≫ u) (δ ≫ α) v β).hom ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ u α).hom ▷ evalMap v β ≫
        (α_ (evalMap s δ) (evalMap u α) (evalMap v β)).hom ≫
        evalMap s δ ◁ (evalMapComp u α v β).inv ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ (u ≫ v) (α ≫ β)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_associator_rhs_app
statement:
lemma eval_associator_rhs_app (s : x ⟶ y) (δ : F ⟶ G) (u : y ⟶ z) (α : G ⟶ H)
    (v : z ⟶ t) (β : H ⟶ E) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    ((evalMapComp (s ≫ u) (δ ≫ α) v β).hom ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ u α).hom ▷ evalMap v β ≫
        (α_ (evalMap s δ) (evalMap u α) (evalMap v β)).hom ≫
        evalMap s δ ◁ (evalMapComp u α v β).inv ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ (u ≫ v) (α ≫ β)).inv).toNatTrans.app Z
      = (evalMapComp (s ≫ u) (δ ≫ α) v β).hom.toNatTrans.app Z ≫
        (β.app t).toFunctor.map ((H.map v).toFunctor.map
          ((evalMapComp s δ u α).hom.toNatTrans.app Z)) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        (evalMapComp u α v β).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((δ.app y).toFunctor.obj ((F.map s).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ (u ≫ v) (α ≫ β)).inv.toNatTrans.app Z

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_left_unitor
statement:
lemma eval_left_unitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (λ_ u).hom (λ_ α).hom
      = (evalMapComp (𝟙 x) (𝟙 F) u α).hom ≫
        (F.mapId x).hom ▷ evalMap u α ≫ (λ_ (evalMap u α)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_left_unitor_rhs_app
statement:
lemma eval_left_unitor_rhs_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (((F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom ▷ (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y)).hom ≫
        F.map (𝟙 x) ◁ ((α_ (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y)) (α.app y)).inv ≫
          ((ρ_ (F.map u)).hom ≫ (λ_ (F.map u)).inv) ▷ α.app y ≫
          (α_ (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u) (α.app y)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u ≫ α.app y)).inv) ≫
      (F.mapId x).hom ▷ evalMap u α ≫ (λ_ (evalMap u α)).hom).toNatTrans.app Z
    = ((𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (α.app y).toFunctor.map ((𝟙 _) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (evalMap u α).toFunctor.map ((F.mapId x).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫ (𝟙 _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_right_unitor
statement:
lemma eval_right_unitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (ρ_ u).hom (ρ_ α).hom
      = (evalMapComp u α (𝟙 y) (𝟙 G)).hom ≫
        evalMap u α ◁ (G.mapId y).hom ≫ (ρ_ (evalMap u α)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_right_unitor_rhs_app
statement:
lemma eval_right_unitor_rhs_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (((F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv ≫
          (α.naturality (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ 𝟙 (G.obj y) ≫
          (α_ (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y)) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y) ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv) ≫
      evalMap u α ◁ (G.mapId y).hom ≫ (ρ_ (evalMap u α)).hom).toNatTrans.app Z
    = ((α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫
            (α.naturality (𝟙 y)).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (G.mapId y).hom.toNatTrans.app ((evalMap u α).toFunctor.obj Z) ≫ (𝟙 _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_whisker_left
statement:
lemma eval_whisker_left (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) {v v' : y ⟶ z} {β β' : G ⟶ H}
    (σ : v ⟶ v') (Γ : β ⟶ β') :
    evalMap₂ (u ◁ σ) (α ◁ Γ)
      = (evalMapComp u α v β).hom ≫ evalMap u α ◁ evalMap₂ σ Γ ≫
        (evalMapComp u α v' β').inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_whisker_right
statement:
lemma eval_whisker_right {u u' : x ⟶ y} {α α' : F ⟶ G} (σ : u ⟶ u') (Γ : α ⟶ α')
    (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    evalMap₂ (σ ▷ v) (Γ ▷ β)
      = (evalMapComp u α v β).hom ≫ evalMap₂ σ Γ ▷ evalMap v β ≫
        (evalMapComp u' α' v β).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_map
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_map (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).map f = x.2.map f.1 ≫ f.2.app y.1

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapComp_hom_app
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapComp_hom_app {a b c : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (f.2.app c.1 ≫ g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj Z))

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapComp_inv_app
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapComp_inv_app {a b c : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).mapComp f g).inv.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality g.1).inv.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫
        (f.2.app c.1 ≫ g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).inv.toNatTrans.app Z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapFunctor
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapFunctor (x y : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).toPrelaxFunctor.mapFunctor x y = evalHom x y

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapId
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapId (x : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).mapId x = x.2.mapId x.1

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapId_hom_app
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapId_hom_app (x : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) (Z : ↑(x.2.obj x.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).mapId x).hom.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (x.2.mapId x.1).hom.toNatTrans.app Z

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_map_eq
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_map_eq (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).map f = (evalHom x y).obj f

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_map_obj
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_map_obj (f : x ⟶ y) (Z : ↑(x.2.obj x.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).map f).toFunctor.obj Z
      = (f.2.app y.1).toFunctor.obj ((x.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj Z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_map₂_app
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_map₂_app {f g : x ⟶ y} (η : f ⟶ g) (Z : ↑(x.2.obj x.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).map₂ η).toNatTrans.app Z
      = (f.2.app y.1).toFunctor.map ((x.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (η.2.as.app y.1).toNatTrans.app ((x.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj Z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_map₂_eq
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_map₂_eq {f g : x ⟶ y} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).map₂ η = (evalHom x y).map η

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_obj
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_obj (x : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).obj x = x.2.obj x.1

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_obj_eq_evalAt
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_obj_eq_evalAt (a : C) (F : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}) :
    (evaluationPseudo (C := C)).obj (a, F) = (evalAt a).obj F
